description: This file contains utility functions for normalizing and handling IRC message targets, allowlists, and sender identification within an IRC extension module.

methods.name: isChannelTarget
methods.description: Checks if a target string is an IRC channel target (starts with '#' or '&').

methods.name: normalizeIrcMessagingTarget
methods.description: Normalizes a raw IRC messaging target string, handling prefixes like 'irc:', 'channel:', and 'user:'.

methods.name: looksLikeIrcTargetId
methods.description: Determines if a string looks like a valid IRC target identifier, excluding control characters.

methods.name: normalizeIrcAllowEntry
methods.description: Normalizes an IRC allowlist entry string by trimming and lowercasing, removing 'irc:' and 'user:' prefixes.

methods.name: normalizeIrcAllowlist
methods.description: Converts an array of entries into a normalized list of allowlist strings.

methods.name: formatIrcSenderId
methods.description: Formats an IRC message sender's identity into a string, including nick, user, and host if available.

methods.name: buildIrcAllowlistCandidates
methods.description: Builds a list of candidate identities from an IRC message for allowlist matching.

methods.name: resolveIrcAllowlistMatch
methods.description: Checks if an IRC message matches an allowlist, returning whether it's allowed and the source.
